justification: Surface A presents no recognisable depicted imagery at all — only an eroded, fissured rock face with natural or quarried vertical breaks — whereas B carries a clear schematic composition of small footprint signs, bird-like figures with legs and beaks, and comb/branch-like linear motifs accompanied by blocks of text. With no figures, symbols or motifs identifiable on A, there is nothing to compare in elements, relationships, arrangement or drawing convention.
